title: RBI Fines Punjab National Bank Rs 1.56 Crore Over Currency Chest Compliance Lapses
case_name: In re: Punjab National Bank (RBI monetary penalty order)
card_summary: The RBI imposed a monetary penalty of about Rs 1.56 crore on Punjab National Bank for non-compliance with its operating guidelines on currency chests. The bank told stock exchanges it received the order on October 29, 2026 and that the financial impact is limited to the penalty amount, with no effect on customer-facing services.
card_tip: Currency chest operations draw RBI penalties on their own compliance record, separate from customer-facing KYC or lending checks. Audit chest-level procedures as their own line item.
verification_notes: Penalty amount (Rs 1.56-1.57 crore, exact figure about Rs 1,56,53,000), date of receipt (29 October 2026) and the stated ground (currency chest operating guideline non-compliance) corroborated across PSU Connect, IndianPSU and Investywise reports of the bank's exchange disclosure. No RBI press release text was located to cross-check the order number.
